PARSE_EXIT="$?"
if [ "$PARSE_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
    rm -f "$RESPONSE_FILE"
    exit "$PARSE_EXIT"
fi

TARGET_EXIT_CODE="$(printf '%s\n' "$PARSED" | sed -n '1p')"
TRACE_VALID="$(printf '%s\n' "$PARSED" | sed -n '2p')"
ATTEMPT_ID="$(printf '%s\n' "$PARSED" | sed -n '3p')"
if [ "$TRACE_VALID" != "true" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "Error: server rejected the candidate trace format; fix it and resubmit."
    rm -f "$RESPONSE_FILE"
    exit 2
fi

cp "$TRACE_FILE" /workspace/.latest_candidate_trace.json
printf '%s\n' "$ATTEMPT_ID" > /workspace/.poc_submission_recorded
rm -f "$RESPONSE_FILE"

case "$TARGET_EXIT_CODE" in
    0|300) exit 0 ;;
    *) exit 1 ;;
esac
---

BUILD=$WORK/meson
rm -rf $BUILD
mkdir $BUILD
meson $BUILD   -Doss_fuzz=enabled   -Db_lundef=false   -Ddefault_library=static   -Dlibmount=disabled
ninja -C $BUILD
find $BUILD/fuzzing -maxdepth 1 -executable -type f -exec cp "{}" $OUT \;
find fuzzing -type f -name "*.dict" -exec cp "{}" $OUT \;
for CORPUS in $(find fuzzing -type f -name "*.corpus"); do
  BASENAME=${CORPUS##*/}
  zip $OUT/${BASENAME%%.*}_seed_corpus.zip . -ws -r -i@$CORPUS
done
